description: Pixel age from Present() submission to a (1, 3, 640, 640) FP16 tensor on CUDA, per capture path. Medians across 3 passes of 8 s per path; min/max are the per-pass extremes. Every path verified before timing. Supersedes the single 5 s pass recorded 2026-09-10.
machine: Machine B: Intel UHD capture, RTX 4060 Laptop CUDA, 2560x1600 at 165 Hz

rapidshot-direct.unavailable: CrossAdapterRequired: no CUDA device owns the adapter this frame was captured on. On a hybrid laptop that is expected: capture runs on the integrated GPU and CUDA only sees the discrete one. The frame has to cross adapters first — see native.cross_adapter_transfer() and ROADMAP § 6.1.
